candidates.snippet: Poland offered Ukraine to build a Patriot factory on Polish soil if Kyiv gets a US license. Deputy Defense Minister Magdalena Sobkowiak-Czarnecka said Poland wants it on “safe territory” instead of inside Ukraine.

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov says giving Starlink data for strikes deep into Russia would be “very destructive”, potentially dangerous and reckless. He also claims Russia’s Starlink analogue, the Rassvet system, should soon work more effectively.
Peskov claims the ruling party United Russia’s win shows Russians are consolidating around the president and supporting his policies.
